info.name: Appen Platform Account Info Monitor Contributors API

params.name: job_id
params.description: A unique identifier for a job or task that is distributed to contributors. Variable name: `{job_id}`.

params.name: key
params.description: Your personal Appen API key; used to access the Appen platform. Can be found in your [account settings](https://client.appen.com/account/api). Variable name: `{api_key}`.

params.name: contributor_id
params.description: A unique identifier for an individual contributor who provides judgements (annotations) on units. Variable name: `{contributor_id}`.

params.name: amount
params.description: A USD value specified in cents i.e. $5.00 == `amount=500`

items.docs:
Pay a Contributor Bonus. Deposits bonus payment amount specified in the
request into the indicated Contributor's account. Corresponds to Award
Bonus button in the UI.

items.docs:
Notify a Contributor. Notifies a Contributor with the message provided
in the request.  The notification appears in the Contributor's
dashboard. Corresponds to the Notify Contributor button showns in the
UI.

params.name: flag
params.description:
Flags a contributor with the reason indicated in the request.
Corresponds to the Flag button on the Contributors page.

params.name: unflag
params.description: Unflags a contributor with the reason indicated in the request

params.name: persist
params.description:
Flags a contributor with the reason indicated in the request across
all jobs for a user. Corresponds to the Flag button on the
Contributors page.
